summary: Describes how SNMPv1, SNMPv2 and SNMPv3 can coexist, so that systems using different versions of the management framework can work together. It obsoletes RFC 1908 and RFC 2089 and was replaced by RFC 3584.

eli5.summary: Old and new versions of the network-monitoring language need to work together. This explains how they can talk without confusion.

questions: how do different snmp versions work together
